name: Namekagon River (St. Croix National Scenic Riverway)
blurb: The Namekagon River in the St. Croix National Scenic Riverway between NPS and Wisconsin DNR-listed landings, with NPS paddling-guide river miles and dam portages.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.takeOut: County Road M Landing (St. Croix NSR)
sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage follows the agency river-mile information cited in the research. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.

notices.title: Start below Namekagon Dam
notices.text: Use the designated downstream canoe launch at Namekagon Dam. The NPS guide notes numerous beaver dams and low bridges in the upper river; low water can make passage difficult. Check current conditions and be prepared to carry.

putInAccess.accessType: Carry-in canoe/kayak access (WDNR boat access 'CARRY-IN'), ramp type Gravel
putInAccess.operator: NPS Visitor Center (ownership 'Federal' in the WDNR record)
putInAccess.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — public boat access inventory
putInAccess.note: The original agency canoe-access point is on the bank below Namekagon Dam, at the end of the clearing approach. NPS Map 1 identifies this start. The nearby NPS points upstream of the dam and inland in the trees are not substituted. Agency evidence and satellite imagery reviewed together in a desktop check on 2026-10-31. This is not a field survey; confirm current signs and conditions. Non-DNR records are not actively maintained by DNR.
